name: Sacred Flame
description: Evocation cantrip, range 60 feet. Radiance descends on one creature, which makes a Dexterity saving throw against the caster's spell save DC. On a failure it takes 1d8 radiant damage (2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th, 4d8 at 17th) and gains no benefit from cover. Costs no spell slot.
